```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data_list <- vector("list", length = 20)

for (s in 1:20) {
  set.seed(s)
  
  n <- 100
  x1 <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.5)
  x2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 39, sd = 5)
  x3 <- x1 * x2
  eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  y <- 1 + x1 + 0.5 * x2 + 0.25 * x3 + eps

  df <- data.frame(
    x1 = x1,
    x2 = x2,
    x3 = x3,
    y = y
  )
  
  data_list[[s]] <- df
}

head(data_list[[1]])
```
```{r}
ggplot(data_list[[1]], aes(x = x2, y = y, color = factor(x1))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "X2",
    y = "Y",
    color = "X1"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
